messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: co-hosted session at CloudWeek next Tue. Need: confirmed speaker, 90s demo happy path + 60s fallback video, swag drop plan.
Raj S (Events): I can confirm speaker ops. Ask partner for deck + bio by Mon EOD. Mic check 15m before slot.
Noah (Eng): I'll create a health-check that auto-switches to the fallback video if local device fails. Command: `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9001/ok || ./play_fallback.sh`.
Lina (Logistics): Partner courier ETA Mon 18:30. They have 80 tees, 150 stickers, 20 battery packs. Batteries may be held in customs.
Maya (Partnerships): If batteries held, swap with extra tees and stickers. Also add QR linking to the recorded clip + lead form.
Raj S (Events): Run-of-show draft: 11:00 intro, 11:02 demo (90s), 11:04 quick Qs, 11:07 redirect to partner table.
Noah (Eng): I'll upload fallback clip to both booth laptop and cloud. PR to demo repo when done.
EventBot: Reminder: upload AV deck to venue AV portal by Mon 12:00 to avoid encoding delays.
Maya (Partnerships): Great—I'll compile the runbook and confirm on-site contact. Closing when deck + clip + health-check + locker confirmed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
